educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn how to use active listening techniques (2) Learn how to use questioning techniques (3) Learn communication styles (4) Acquire verbal and nonverbal skills essential for delivering oral presentations
advice: This is a basic communication skills course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Basic communication skills 2. Active listening techniques 3. Questioning techniques 4. Communication styles 5. Presentation basics Students are required to participate actively in class. Students are expected to work together in pairs/groups to complete tasks in class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the factors of effective communication.
Be able to explain the four main styles of communication.
Be able to explain ways of communicating with people having different communication styles.
Be able to improve the verbal and nonverbal skills needed to deliver an oral presentation.
Be able to deliver attractive presentations with clear and meaningful visual aids.
Be able to self-assess the state of attainment of target abilities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the importance of active listening, and utilize its techniques. (2) Fully understand DiSC theory, and explain the DiSC Personality Types (D [dominance], I [influence], S [steadiness], and C [conscientiousness] in detail. (3) Fully understand how to use DiSC theory, and explain it specifically, in communication with others. (4) Use the verbal and nonverbal skills needed to deliver an oral presentation.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the meaning and importance of active listening. (2) Understand the basics of DiSC theory. (3) Understand how to use DiSC theory in communication with others. (4) Explain the key points of delivering effective presentations.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
